meta_description: Inside the dual-city practice of Silver & Elegant — London design and Istanbul master craftsmanship.

sections.label: The Founder
sections.title: Esen Tunalı Sarı FRSA
sections.body: SILVER & ELEGANT reflects the design discipline and creative direction of its founder, Esen Tunalı Sarı, FRSA. Bridging architectural structure, classical jewellery traditions, and computational design, the London studio develops sculptural works conceived for permanence. The practice rejects trend-driven cycles in favour of resolved, enduring form.

sections.label: The Craft / Production
sections.title: Atelier Kapalıçarşı
sections.body: Our collection encompasses two distinct design paths: classical pieces developed through traditional design methods in Türkiye, and computational concepts developed within our studio. Physical production is concentrated entirely in Istanbul’s Grand Bazaar, brought into reality by a single master artisan. Completed physical editions are hand-finished individually, while pending algorithmic designs remain precisely resolved prior to physical execution.

sections.label: The Workspace
sections.title: Borehamwood & Istanbul
sections.body: The studio operates between London and Istanbul. Design direction, computational development, and material alignment under the Physical Fidelity Protocol take place in London. Classical design iterations and single-artisan physical casting are executed in Istanbul’s Grand Bazaar. This dual structure maintains both conceptual rigor and master-level metal discipline.
